svg.title: Breadboard wiring for the 3-button Simon Says
svg.desc: LED long legs in c5, c15 and c25 with short legs in c6, c16, c26. 330 ohm resistors from a6, a16, a26 to the minus rail. Buttons in c9 and c11, c19 and c21, c29 and c31, with short wires from a11, a21, a31 to the minus rail. Buzzer plus leg in c36, other leg in c39 with a wire from a39 to the minus rail. ESP32 wires: GPIO25 to e5, GPIO32 to e9, GPIO26 to e15, GPIO33 to e19, GPIO27 to e25, GPIO14 to e29, GPIO13 to e36, GND to the minus rail.
